items.title: J.K. Dobbins: Grinds out yards, TD in OT win
items.text:
Dobbins rushed 17 times for 41 yards and a touchdown and brought in all three targets for five yards during the Broncos' 17-14 overtime win over the Seahawks on Thursday.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Jaxon Smith-Njigba: Massive numbers after slow start
items.text:
Smith-Njigba brought in 12 of 16 targets for 134 yards in the Seahawks' 17-14 overtime loss to the Broncos on Thursday.

items.title: Jaylen Waddle: Back in Thursday's game
items.text:
Waddle suffered a shoulder injury in the third quarter of Thursday's game against the Seahawks but was able to return, Parker Gabriel of The Denver Post and Zac Stevens of TheDNVR.com report.
